records.title: 本地理念：符文与气合作研究报告
records.description: 理念引1473报告称符文与气不能直接融合，但工具可共同使用，梯田试验成功、精细制造部分成功。1473为报告署年，非技术首次发现年。

dateEvidence.evidenceScope: 本地理念文学与设定叙述；未经独立正史来源确认；不因理念可解锁而证明该年国家存在。

locators.excerpt:
“After a series of experiments, we have found that while runic and chi energies are mostly incompatible, they are not destabilized by proximity to each other. Therefore, while it is not currently possible to directly infuse runes with chi, they can be used in combination. Further testing should be considered immediately.

RUNIC-CHI COOPERATION TERRACING: SUCCESS
Runic tools were handed out to a small contingent of Chi Terraformers, who were told to use them to construct terraces in the hills north-east of Patu. They reported a significant increase in efficiency, as they experienced success transmuting the runic tools to fit their needs, using them as a conduit for chi energy.

RUNIC-CHI COMBINED MANUFACTURING: PARTIAL SUCCESS
Runic tools were handed out to a small contingent of Chi users with expertise in artisanship, who were told to use them to produce their products. While there was some difficulty in adapting the combined energies to more delicate work, skill with Chi was directly correlated to more efficient production.”

– Research report on the combination of Runic magic and Chi energies, 1473

records.description: 理念引1478报告记围城后城防未破、约三千军人及五百矮人炮手；该年是报告观察点，不当作围城发生或解除日，报告“不可攻破”为主观评价。

locators.excerpt:
“Despite recent sieges, the fort is mostly intact. Recent reinforcements to its already sturdy construction have ensured that Patu will not fall for a long time. Surveys have found no breaches, despite some damage due to artillery shelling. It is estimated that three thousand soldiers currently reside inside Patu, with about six hundred of these being wounded. Five hundred dwarven artillerists – accompanying a recent complement of Ozovari artillery – assist them, and of the several thousand civilians sheltering within, those that have not been taken on as helpers have begun to filter home

In short, Patu is impregnable. Its position in the mountains, which force any conqueror to attack the disciplined Patu garrison from a single direction, makes the constant stream of Duandi reinforcements all the more effective. The artillery functions impeccably, the walls hold, the garrison stands. If there was ever proof of the Duandi’s mastery of engineering, I am currently in command of it.”

– Yearly Patu Fortress report, 1478
